scheme_name: Scheme of Awarding Porkizhi to the Indigent Kalaimamani Awardee Artists
description:
The Scheme of Awarding Porkizhi to the Indigent Kalaimamani Awardee Artists was launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu in 2017. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to artists who have been honored with the Kalaimamani Award but are facing financial difficulties. 

The Kalaimamani Award is a prestigious recognition given by the Tamil Nadu Government to artists for their exceptional contributions to the fields of art and culture. 

The Porkizhi financial assistance is specifically designed to support those awardees who are in dire need of monetary help due to their indigent status. 

Under this scheme, each eligible artist receives a monthly pension of ₹1,500. 

This amount is intended to provide a basic level of financial security to the awardees. 

The scheme recognizes the contributions of artists who have enriched Tamil culture and heritage. 

The assistance is aimed at ensuring that these artists can continue to live with dignity despite their financial hardships. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specifically defined. 

Only those artists who have received the Kalaimamani Award are eligible for this financial assistance. 

Additionally, the artists must demonstrate that they are indigent and in need of financial support. 

There are no specific age limits mentioned for eligibility. 

However, the artists must provide proof of their award status and financial condition. 

The application process for the Porkizhi scheme is straightforward. 

Artists must submit an application form to the Department of Arts and Culture in Tamil Nadu. 

The application form can be obtained from the official website of the Tamil Nadu Government or directly from the department's office. 

Along with the application form, artists must submit a copy of their Kalaimamani Award certificate. 

They must also provide documents that demonstrate their financial status. 

This may include income certificates or any other relevant financial documents. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The review process includes verification of the award status and the financial condition of the applicant. 

If approved, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the bank account of the artist. 

The disbursement of the monthly pension occurs on the first week of every month. 

This ensures that the artists receive their financial support in a timely manner. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Arts and Culture, Government of Tamil Nadu. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and ensuring that the funds are distributed appropriately. 

Artists can contact the department for any queries related to the scheme. 

The contact details for the Department of Arts and Culture can be found on the official Tamil Nadu Government website. 

The scheme has been well-received by the artistic community in Tamil Nadu. 

It has provided much-needed support to many artists who have dedicated their lives to the arts. 

As of 2023, the scheme has benefited over 500 artists. 

This number reflects the government's commitment to supporting its cultural heritage. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a vital resource for many awardees. 

It allows them to cover basic living expenses such as food and healthcare. 

The Tamil Nadu Government has allocated a budget of ₹1 crore for this scheme in the financial year 2023-2024. 

This budget is intended to ensure that all eligible artists receive the support they need. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Tamil Nadu Government to promote and preserve the arts. 

It recognizes the importance of artists in society and aims to provide them with a safety net. 

The Porkizhi scheme is a testament to the government's dedication to cultural preservation. 

It highlights the need to support those who have contributed significantly to the arts. 

The scheme also encourages younger generations to pursue careers in the arts. 

By providing financial support to established artists, the government fosters a vibrant cultural environment. 

The initiative reflects the values of respect and appreciation for artistic contributions. 

Overall, the Scheme of Awarding Porkizhi to the Indigent Kalaimamani Awardee Artists is a crucial welfare initiative. 

It addresses the financial challenges faced by award-winning artists. 

The scheme ensures that these artists can continue to contribute to Tamil culture without the burden of financial stress. 

The ongoing support from the Tamil Nadu Government demonstrates a commitment to the arts. 

This scheme serves as a model for other states to consider similar initiatives for their artists. 

In conclusion, the Porkizhi scheme is an essential lifeline for many deserving artists in Tamil Nadu. 

It not only provides financial assistance but also acknowledges the invaluable contributions of artists to society.
